digest.component_or_area: outbound parent write paths (CREATE emit and ACLI attach fallback)
propositions: CREATE emit path (slot 2) drops a non-epic parent silently with logger.debug and no durable bridge_alerts entry, failing to signal to operators that the hierarchy diverged at birth
ACLI attach fallback (slot 4) swallows HTTP 400 when Jira rejects a non-epic parent, logging WARNING but never calling record_parent_divergence to create an outbound-parent-rejected alert

suppressed_out keyword parameter must thread through OutboundMapper.map_local_to_remote to collect dropped field keys only when the parent is bound to a Jira key, preserving silence for unbound parents that converge on a later pass
slot 4 must record parent divergence using the existing outbound-parent-rejected kind via pass_io.record_parent_divergence to align with dispatch_one's handling of the same rejection shape

documentation and comments diverge on whether the epic-only parent guard is Cloud-specific or universal; docs must clarify Data Center behavior (accept-and-ignore) versus Cloud behavior (HTTP 400) to justify the unconditional guard
